Date: Wed, 23 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API eval — signup confirmation

Hi team,

I signed up for the Hosted API eval via your site this morning — thanks for making the sandbox easy to spin up. We're BlueCart (operations/product) and would like a short walkthrough focused on inference latency and cost tradeoffs for chat+embedding flows.

Our timezone is Pacific (PDT). Ideal windows are:
- Tue/Wed mornings (10–12 PT)
- Thu afternoon (1–4 PT)

Would love a 30–45 minute slot next week if available.

Best,
Alex Turner
Product Lead | BlueCart
alex.turner@bluecart.ai

P.S. happy to share a short list of sample prompts in advance — will attach if useful.

Hi Alex — thanks for signing up and for the context. I can run the walkthrough myself or pull Diego in for the sandbox provisioning details; Mina typically handles timezone coordination for EU/APAC but is cc'd in case you need a different cadence.

Quick plan and asks: 
- Length: 30 minutes (concise technical + demo) with 15 minutes of Q&A.
- Goals: latency/cost profiling, simple prompt recipes for chat + embeddings, and a short look at batch vs stream.
- Prework: if you can drop 3 representative prompts and an example call volume (requests/min) that'd help us tailor the demo.

I have a few 'slot buckets' next week (all PT):
- Option A: Tue 10:30–11:00 or Tue 11:30–12:00
- Option B: Wed 10:00–10:45
- Option C: Thu 13:00–13:45 or Thu 15:00–15:45

If none of those work, tell me two preferred windows and Diego will try to stitch a calendar match (we sometimes combine smaller buckets).

Also attaching a short preflight checklist and the sandbox invite once you confirm a slot — Diego will share both.

Thanks — I can hold Option A Tue 10:30 if you want to lock for now.

Best,
Karthik
SDR | Redwood Inference
